version.note: Selected explicitly by id. COMM.VERS is ephemeral client metadata and cannot select a schema; the live tree pair is shared with the measured 2.10 corpus.

constants.comment: Declared here for the record. The reader takes them from e3d_io::schema::E3D31, because they are needed where no manifest is loaded.

binaries.comment: AVEVA installation files, carried in ./binaries/ so this pack needs no path from outside it. They are not redistributable, so that directory is git-ignored and a fresh clone has to refill it; $E3D31_SCHEMA_DIR names an installation to read instead.

catalog.comment: Live read-only export taken beside the binaries above. Optional logical metadata; physical layout never comes from here.

metadata.comment: Regenerated by `e3d-descriptor compile-metadata`; git-ignored, listed so the path is one convention rather than a flag.
